projects.name: Lathrop Megafactory
projects.quote: Ramp of Powerwall 3 and the Lathrop Megafactory continued successfully – with Lathrop demonstrating 200 Megapack production (40 GWh annual run rate) in a single week.

projects.name: Shanghai Megafactory
projects.quote: The Shanghai Megafactory remains on track to begin shipping Megapacks in Q1 2025.
